name: md-mobile-monorepo
description: MD Mobile - Fullstack E-Commerce Platform (Next.js Frontend + Express Backend)

scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
